Ertiga: Pawar 14,500, Trodly 15,360. Median of the four sedan quotes = 10,500.

taxi_day.basis: Pune-based Ashtavinayak circuit operators, 2-day / 1-night sedan package (4 pages fetched): Pawar Travels 10,500 (Dzire/Xcent CNG; page footer 2026); Sainath Cab 10,500 (page footer 2019); Trodly 12,480 (700 km limit, extra 12/km; toll and parking excluded); Jay Bhagvan Travels 10,000 (600 km, 12-13/km, undated). Median 10,500. The temple village is a stop on this circuit, not a standalone cab hire.
taxi_day.notes: No local 8 h rate exists for this village; cabs come from Pune. Pawar's 2-day route: Pune, Theur, Moregaon, Siddhatek, Ranjangaon, Ozar (night), then Lenyadri, Mahad, Pali, Pune. Sedan per-km on the Jay Bhagvan page is 13 (300 km/day basis) in one table and 12 in another.

food_per_person_day.basis: No temple-town thali or restaurant price shown on a page I could read.
